style: Franco-Belgian clear-line adventure comic illustration for children aged nine, crisp even black outlines, flat bright colours with simple shadows, detailed precise backgrounds that show exactly the place described, outdoors or indoors (an outdoor scene has no walls, no ceiling and no windows at all); only when the scene is inside a room, any open window shows only sky, water and distant mountains, lit as the stated time of day requires (dark night sky at night), every window in one picture showing the same sky and the same light, never a building or a tower, every clock face marked only with small dots, expressive children with natural proportions, in the spirit of classic illustrated adventure albums. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles.
style_fiches: Franco-Belgian clear-line adventure comic illustration for children aged nine, crisp even black outlines, flat bright colours with simple shadows, expressive characters with natural proportions. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles. No scenery, no landscape.

personnages.elias: one eleven-year-old boy, the tallest of all, lanky with long arms and legs, light olive skin, dark brown eyes, short curly black hair, a pencil tucked behind his right ear, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching his elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright emerald green knitted sweater, a long bright yellow scarf, dark grey trousers and brown lace-up ankle boots, a small black notebook in his hand
personnages.maya: one ten-year-old girl of medium height, sturdy and lively, dark brown skin, bright dark eyes, black hair in two big round afro puffs, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching her elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright orange knitted sweater, a long bright yellow scarf, a dark grey skirt, white tights and brown lace-up ankle boots, a small patchwork cloth bag across her shoulder
personnages.tom: one nine-year-old boy, the smallest of all, thin and wiry, fair skin covered in freckles, green eyes, messy bright copper-red hair, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching his elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over bright turquoise dungarees far too big for him, rolled up at the ankles, and a white shirt, a long bright yellow scarf wound twice around his neck, small brown ankle boots, a folded wooden carpenter's rule sticking out of his chest pocket
personnages.kenza: one eleven-year-old girl, tall and slim, very upright with her chin lifted, warm light brown skin, dark brown eyes, very long glossy black hair in one thick braid down to her waist, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching her elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright fuchsia pink knitted sweater, a long bright violet scarf thrown over one shoulder, a dark grey skirt, dark grey tights and brown lace-up ankle boots, a large old iron key on a ribbon around her neck
personnages.sami: one ten-year-old boy, short and round with a soft tummy, light golden-tan skin, sleepy half-closed dark almond-shaped eyes, straight black hair flopping over his forehead, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching his elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright red knitted sweater, a long bright violet scarf, dark grey trousers and brown ankle boots with the laces undone, a small plump cushion with red and white stripes under his arm
personnages.nour: one ten-year-old girl, small and slim, very neat and upright, warm beige skin, large hazel eyes, shoulder-length curly dark brown hair held back by a white headband, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching her elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright royal blue knitted sweater, no scarf at all, a dark grey skirt, white knee socks and polished black buckled shoes, a small brown leather satchel across her shoulder
personnages.zora: one tall strong broad-shouldered woman of about fifty-five, brown weathered skin, dark eyes, short curly grey hair under a wide-brimmed dark green waxed hat, wearing a long dark green waxed coat over a thick cream sweater, brown trousers tucked into tall brown leather boots, a big iron ring of old keys hanging from her belt
personnages.idris: one very old small thin man of about eighty, dark brown skin with deep wrinkles, kind dark eyes, a bald head with a ring of short white hair, a short white beard, round brass spectacles pushed up on his forehead, wearing a rust-brown waistcoat with many small pockets over a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, baggy dark blue trousers and soft grey slippers, a large brass clock-winding key in his hand
personnages.ada: one small round brisk woman of about forty-five, light brown skin, lively dark eyes, black hair streaked with grey in a messy bun held by two pencils, wearing a long teal work coat with rolled-up sleeves, spotted with black ink, over a white blouse, a dark skirt and black ankle boots, fingertips black with ink, a long thin paintbrush in her hand

lieux.haute_lanterne: an old lighthouse-castle of pale grey stone forming one single building on one bare rock island in the middle of a wide calm mountain lake: in the centre a tall smooth round lighthouse tower with a plain round top, on its left and on its right two long low wings with grey slate roofs and rows of small windows, both wings joined directly to the foot of the tower; at the very top of the tower a round glass lamp room under a small dark slate dome, the lamp room glowing pale gold, a small wooden landing stage at the foot of the rock, dark pine forests on the far shores and snowy peaks behind
lieux.haute_lanterne_eteinte: an old lighthouse-castle of pale grey stone forming one single building on one bare rock island in the middle of a wide calm mountain lake: in the centre a tall smooth round lighthouse tower with a plain round top, on its left and on its right two long low wings with grey slate roofs and rows of small windows, both wings joined directly to the foot of the tower; at the very top of the tower a round glass lamp room under a small dark slate dome, the lamp room dark and unlit, every window dark, dark pine forests on the far shores and snowy peaks behind
lieux.ponton: a small wooden landing stage at the foot of a grey rock in a mountain lake, a long flight of worn stone steps climbing from it toward the pale grey stone walls of an old lighthouse-castle above, an iron mooring ring, a rough wooden bench, calm clear water all around
lieux.salle_horloges: a high vaulted stone hall used as a dining room, one whole wall covered from floor to ceiling with about a hundred clocks of every shape and size, pendulum clocks, round dials and tiny carriage clocks, their hands all pointing in different directions, every dial blank and pale and marked only with small black dots, two rows of long wooden tables and benches separated by one straight line of polished brass set into the stone floor, a tall wooden ladder leaning against the clock wall, tall windows at both ends of the hall
lieux.cour: a small paved courtyard enclosed on three sides by one single old castle of pale grey stone: across the whole back of the courtyard rises the wide curved base of a tall round stone tower, standing right on the paving stones, and on the left and on the right the walls of the castle's two wings, joined to the tower; one straight line of polished brass set into the paving stones runs across the whole courtyard, and a long plain stone bench stands across this line so that the line cuts it exactly in the middle
lieux.couloir_impair: a long narrow castle corridor, its walls hung with faded blue cloth, a worn dark red carpet on the floor, a row of small round windows on one side, unlit brass lanterns hanging from hooks on the other side, the corridor closed at each end by one plain wooden door, both doors exactly alike
lieux.perchoir: a round attic bedroom under the pointed roof of an old castle, thick slanting wooden beams, three small beds with yellow blankets, one big round window looking out over a mountain lake far below, a sturdy round wooden table in the middle, shelves crowded with rolled papers, old ink pots and brushes
lieux.taniere: a low vaulted stone bedroom at water level in an old castle, three small beds with violet blankets, one wide arched window just above a mountain lake, a workbench covered with old brass lantern parts, small panes of glass and tools, heaps of cushions on the stone floor
lieux.bibliotheque: a tall round library inside a stone tower, curved wooden shelves up to the ceiling filled with old books whose covers are all held shut by small leather straps, a spiral staircase of dark wood, reading desks with brass lanterns, a round glass skylight in the ceiling
lieux.terrasse: a narrow stone terrace high above a wide mountain lake, at the foot of the pale grey stone walls of an old lighthouse-castle, in its middle a small square lawn of perfect bright green grass edged with low iron hoops, a stone balustrade, a flight of stone steps going down toward the water
lieux.mur_couloir: a bare stone landing inside an old castle, enclosed by stone walls on every side, ending in one solid blank wall of pale stone with no door, no window and no opening of any kind, a worn dark red carpet stopping dead against that wall
lieux.porte_cachee: the middle of a long narrow castle corridor hung with faded blue cloth, a worn dark red carpet on the floor, the blue cloth pulled aside like a curtain to show a small low door of dark wood with no handle and no keyhole
lieux.escalier_tour: a narrow spiral staircase of pale stone climbing inside a round tower, small arched windows, worn steps
lieux.sommet_tour: the round lamp room at the top of a lighthouse tower, tall panes of glass all around, in the middle a huge old lantern of brass and glass as tall as a child standing on a stone base, a wide mountain lake and distant peaks far below
lieux.rive: a wooden jetty on the pine-covered shore of a wide mountain lake, a small boat shed with a slate roof beside it, far away across the water an old lighthouse-castle on a rock island, a tall round tower between two long low wings
lieux.remise: a small stone boat shed at the foot of a castle rock, oars leaning in a corner, coils of rope and tins of varnish on a shelf, on the wall a wooden board covered with rows of small chalk squares, most of them crossed out, a tiny boat drawn in chalk in the last square, no numbers
lieux.chambre_deux_fenetres: a small round stone workroom inside a tower, one long worktable in the middle with rolled parchments, ink pots and brass lantern parts, two wooden stools, a plank floor, on the back wall three old clocks with blank faces marked only with dots, the back wall plain stone with no window; one tall narrow window opening without glass in the left wall and one in the right wall, facing each other across the room, each with one wooden shutter
lieux.chambre_close: a small round stone workroom inside a tower, one long worktable in the middle with rolled parchments, ink pots and brass lantern parts, two wooden stools, a plank floor, on the back wall three old clocks with blank faces marked only with dots, the back wall plain stone with no window; on the left wall and on the right wall, two tall narrow wooden shutters, both shut flat like two plain wooden doors set into the stone, no sky and no landscape visible anywhere
lieux.chambre_un_volet: a small round stone workroom inside a tower, one long worktable in the middle with rolled parchments, ink pots and brass lantern parts, two wooden stools, a plank floor, on the back wall three old clocks with blank faces marked only with dots, the back wall plain stone with no window; in the left wall one tall narrow window opening without glass, wide open, its wooden shutter folded back; in the right wall a tall narrow wooden shutter shut flat like a plain wooden door, no sky visible on the right

objets.moitie_levant: the right half of an imaginary hand-drawn plan of the castle in brown ink on yellowed parchment, drawings only, no letters, no words, no compass rose, not a world map, no continents: a piece of lake, half of a round tower and a tiny ink boat pushing against the left edge; its left edge is cut into a zigzag of seven big pointed teeth; lying flat, seen at a low angle
objets.moitie_couchant: the left half of an imaginary hand-drawn plan of the castle in brown ink on yellowed parchment, drawings only, no letters, no words, no compass rose, not a world map, no continents: a piece of lake, half of a round tower and a tiny ink landing stage with a tiny lantern, right against the right edge; its right edge is cut into seven deep V-shaped notches; lying flat, seen at a low angle
objets.carte: two halves of an imaginary hand-drawn plan of the castle in brown ink on yellowed parchment, drawings only, no letters, no words, no compass rose, not a world map, no continents, pushed together along a zigzag cut where seven teeth fit into seven notches: in the middle a big round tower with a small round room inside it, two windows facing each other, two tiny ink figures at a table, a tiny boat moored at a tiny landing stage, and around the room four small drawn signs, a clock with one hand, a book with two straps, a door between two doors and a small flame; lying flat, seen at a low angle
objets.luciole: a long narrow wooden rowing boat painted dark green, with three plank seats and one long oar at the back, three wooden hoops arching over it from side to side, small brass and glass lanterns hanging from the three hoops
objets.lanterne: a small brass hand lantern with a round glass body and a ring handle on top, as big as a jam jar, one steady drop-shaped golden flame floating in the middle of the empty glass, with nothing under it and nothing above it
objets.lanterne_eteinte: a small brass hand lantern with a round glass body and a ring handle on top, as big as a jam jar, the glass dark and empty, unlit
objets.horloge_de_personne: a large round wall clock, bigger than every other clock, with a dark midnight-blue dial, its rim marked only with fifteen small gold notches, and only one hand: a single long gold hand, nothing else on the dial
objets.boutons: three big round coat buttons lying apart from each other: one green, one orange and one bright turquoise
objets.cruche: a large round earthenware water jug with two handles
objets.coffre: an old wooden chest bound with iron bands, as big as a suitcase, its lid open
objets.corbeille: a big round wicker basket full of small round bread rolls
objets.metre: a folding wooden carpenter's rule, unfolded in a zigzag
objets.premiere_lanterne: a tiny old lantern no bigger than a pear: one small round ball of thick clear glass held in a thin cage of dark brass, with two small round loop handles sticking out on opposite sides, one on the left and one on the right; a soft round golden glow floats inside the glass ball, fully enclosed in it; it looks nothing like a storm lantern or a hurricane lamp: no candle, no wick, no chimney, nothing rising out of its top
objets.chaussures: six pairs of children's shoes and ankle boots, empty, standing side by side in one neat straight row on the floor
objets.theiere: a big round brown teapot under a knitted tea cosy, steaming cups, a rack of toast and a pot of orange marmalade
objets.pupitre: an old sloping wooden reading desk standing on four thin legs, its front right leg shorter than the three others
objets.livre_fondateurs: a thick old book bound in midnight blue leather, flattened and worn, with no title, held shut by two leather straps with small brass buckles, one on each side
objets.livre_ouvert: a thick old book bound in midnight blue leather lying wide open, its two leather straps hanging loose, its pages covered with tiny ink drawings and no writing, seen from the side at a low angle
objets.portraits: two old oval painted portraits in dark wooden frames hanging side by side on a stone wall: on the left an old woman with white hair in a bun and a quill pen behind her ear, painted in profile and facing left, toward the outer edge; on the right an old man with a short grey beard holding a small brass lantern, painted in profile and facing right, toward the outer edge, so that the two turn their backs to each other
objets.portraits_face: two old oval painted portraits in dark wooden frames hanging side by side on a stone wall: on the left an old woman with white hair in a bun and a quill pen behind her ear, painted in profile and facing right; on the right an old man with a short grey beard holding a small brass lantern, painted in profile and facing left, so that the two look at each other
objets.trait_craie: one straight white chalk line drawn across the wooden plank floor from the doorway to the opposite wall, passing right under the middle of the table
objets.caisse: a big wooden crate as large as a trunk, tied with thick rope
objets.echarpe_deux: a long knitted scarf, bright violet at one end and bright yellow at the other
objets.premiere_lanterne_eteinte: a tiny old lantern no bigger than a pear: one small round ball of thick clear glass held in a thin cage of dark brass, with two small round loop handles sticking out on opposite sides, one on the left and one on the right; the glass ball is dark and empty, unlit; it looks nothing like a storm lantern or a hurricane lamp: no candle, no wick, no chimney
